name: JellyWatcher
overview: Your JellyWatcher watchlists and timelines inside Jellyfin
description: Adds a Watchlists page to Jellyfin's menu: add lists by link, follow each list's timeline, and request (Seerr), skip or mark entries as watched without leaving Jellyfin. Needs a JellyWatcher server (https://github.com/TIGamingTV/JellyWatcher) and the File Transformation plugin.
